 The latest injury update for Miami Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo on Thursday, Nov. 5 against the Golden State Warriors. Peter Dewey | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Miami Heat forward Giannis Antetokounmpo. | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Miami Heat UPDATE: Giannis Antetokounmpo is AVAILABLE on Thursday night against Golden State. 
--> UPDATE: Giannis Antetokounmpo is AVAILABLE on Thursday night against Golden State. 
 Miami Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo is dealing with a sprained right wrist that caused him to show up on the injury report on Wednesday ahead of the team's win over the Los Angeles Clippers.
--> Miami Heat star Giannis Antetokounmpo is dealing with a sprained right wrist that caused him to show up on the injury report on Wednesday ahead of the team's win over the Los Angeles Clippers.
 Giannis was listed as probable for that game, and he played over 40 minutes in a one-point win in overtime. The Heat star shot just 8-for-20 from the field, and he reportedly had his wrist heavily taped following Wednesday's win. 
--> Giannis was listed as probable for that game, and he played over 40 minutes in a one-point win in overtime. The Heat star shot just 8-for-20 from the field, and he reportedly had his wrist heavily taped following Wednesday's win. 
 Giannis' sprained right wrist was heavily taped after the game tonight. He also wore a wrap on top of the tape on his wrist.
He was listed as probable for tonight's game vs. Clippers before being cleared to play. Heat back at it tomorrow vs. Warriors in San Francisco.
— Anthony Chiang (@Anthony_Chiang) November 5, 2026 It's possible the Heat could sit Antetokoounmpo on the second night of a back-to-back against the Golden State Warriors on Thursday, especially since yesterday's game went into OT. Miami has yet to release an injury report for Thursday's game, but the Heat are 7.5-point underdogs at DraftKings Sportsbook , which could indicate that oddsmakers are expecting them to be short-handed.

Miami has yet to release an injury report for Thursday's game, but the Heat are 7.5-point underdogs at DraftKings Sportsbook , which could indicate that oddsmakers are expecting them to be short-handed.
 This season, Antetokounmpo is averaging 28.3 points, 12.5 rebounds and 5.8 assists per game while shooting 56.2 percent from the field. Miami is off to a slow start at 3-5, but it may not want to risk the long-term health of the star forward by playing him in this back-to-back.
